units.normalized_content: Exports the minimal package surface for baseline actions/decisions, observations, latent causes, search policies and synthetic cases; module docstring retains historical v0.1 wording.

Implements matched v0.1 baseline/search policies including random, gap, novelty, performance, self-confirming, general-causal and causal-negative-space policies over the same observable state; negative-space-specific naming does not imply unique mechanism warrant.
Defines controlled synthetic observation/case dataclasses and benchmark-local latent-cause labels; the module explicitly supplies data structures rather than a full general environment simulator.
Implements frozen v0.1 synthetic cases, hostile observational-equivalence/model-adequacy pairs, controlled evidence acquisition and simple intervention outcomes with source-authored ground truth.

Implements v0.1/v0.1.1 case, hostile-pair and model-adequacy scoring; comments explicitly limit evaluation to dimensions cleanly identified by current toy environments rather than the full conceptual Q_Psi vector.
Runs canonical v0.1 cases/policies and emits JSON diagnostics; payload explicitly labels the benchmark initial and full Q_Psi not yet implemented.
Runs the v0.1.1 model-adequacy hostile pair across initial policies and emits JSON, retaining frozen-core scope.
Implements the frozen eight-case v0.2 matrix, model/within-model evidence actions, true/false escalation, evidence cost and post-evidence interpretation metrics.

Implements history-aware general-causal and negative-space variants using the same standardized-residual/sign-persistence summary and same escalation threshold; comments call these implementation variants, not new theory objects.
Executes the preregistered v0.2 selective/false-escalation comparison and emits per-policy cases and summaries without a composite score.

Implements misleading generic compressed history versus typed relational history under identical raw data/evidence budgets; typed general-causal and structured-negative-space policies instantiate the same TypedHistoryLearner class with different names.
Computes held-out selection, known transfer, novel model-check, false-model-check and fixed probe-cost summaries for v0.3.
Fits each v0.3 representation policy on frozen training episodes and emits held-out decisions/summaries; status labels it a preregistered representation ablation without composite score.

Implements v0.4 adaptive relation selection from a frozen supplied library of hint and pair relations, repair histories that break surface cues, a fixed typed oracle and compressed-outcome control; it selects relations rather than inventing primitives.
Computes pre/post held-out selection, known selection, novel model-check, false model-check, evidence/representation cost and representation-change rate for v0.4.
Runs v0.4 acquisition then repair for the adaptive learner plus compressed-memory and fixed-oracle controls, reporting Q_repair and representation change.

Implements the supplied v0.4 single-relation basis, all pairwise AND compositions, basis-adequacy threshold, fixed/gated/always-compose/oracle policies, search-cost accounting and frozen training/held-out cases; AND and primitive relations are supplied.

Evaluates v0.5 basis-inadequacy detection, false inadequacy, expansion, target-conjunction construction, held-out transfer, constituent false positives, novelty check, search cost and representation cost.
Executes the preregistered v0.5 basis-failure policies and emits audits, decisions and summaries without a composite score.

Implements the frozen 78-expression v0.5 language, hostile current-language-equivalent trace pairs, assimilator/abstainer/boundary-aware policies, and an oracle supplied two trace-direction operators solely as a recoverability control.
Computes language-inadequacy detection, false inadequacy, nonhallucination, adequate/unknown calibration, expansion requests and oracle recoverability for v0.6.
Runs the v0.6 current-language controls and oracle, emits decisions/summaries and explicitly states operator invention is not attempted.

Implements the finite v0.7 meta-language (t0..t3, ADD/SUB, GT/LT), 26 numeric expressions and 1300 generated predicates, exact synthesis/scoring/retention, two hostile collision families, and matched always-expand versus boundary-gated generic synthesizers differing only in which signatures invoke synthesis.

Computes v0.7 boundary detection, construction success, held-out repair, multi-family transfer, false assimilation/expansion, preservation/unknown calibration, literal candidate-evaluation search cost, representation cost, generated-operator count and Q_invention.
Executes the preregistered v0.7 comparison and emits generated operators, selections, decisions, metric summaries, expression/predicate counts and no composite score.
Tests frozen v0.1/v0.1.1 environment IDs, observational equivalence, discriminating evidence and the intended baseline/policy outcomes including the evidence-selection distinction.

Tests v0.2 matched case counts/costs, opposite frozen-policy errors, selective history-aware behavior, and exact equality of primary metrics for matched history-aware causal and negative-space variants.

Tests non-identifying error magnitude, deliberately misleading compressed history, perfect typed-history transfer and exact decision equality between typed general-causal and negative-space-labelled controls.

Tests frozen raw IDs, absence of semantic labels, supplied candidate library, pre-repair surface-cue preference, complete relation change after repair, 0→1 held-out improvement, compressed-memory failure and oracle upper bound.

Tests frozen v0.5 IDs, initial basis without conjunctions, localized single-basis failure, target AND construction, perfect gated transfer, greater brute-force search cost, oracle equivalence and absence of basis-failure semantic leakage in raw history.

Tests exact 78-expression language, hostile equivalence under every current expression with raw-trace difference, assimilation/abstention/boundary distinctions, unknown preservation and recoverability from the oracle's two extra operators.

Tests finite constant-free generic meta-language, two independent collision families, nonduplicate held-out traces, exact four synthesized predicates, perfect matched repair/transfer, identical generated operators and representation cost, search cost 5200 versus 7800, and no gated synthesis on the unsupported unknown case.
